Tokenization

When we get a paragraph, a paragraph is called as Corpus.
Each sentence is called a Document.
Vocabulary - All unique words present in the paragraph
Words - All words present in Corpus is a word

Tokenization:

Imp step - part of any use case wrt NLP

This entire para is corpus
"My Name is Krish and i have a interest in teaching ML, NLP and Deep learning. I am also a Youtuber."

Tokenization is process, where we take a Paragraph or Sentences and convert into tokens. Output would be sentences or documents.
When Tokenization is done on a Paragraph, every sentence would be a token
When Tokenization is done on Sentence, every word would be a token

Ouput of above Paragraph:

Sentence1/Document1 - My Name is Krish and i have a interest in teaching ML, NLP and Deep learning
Sentence2/Document2 - I am also a Youtuber

Now doing Tokenization again, will convert Sentences to Words

Words - My, Name, is, Krish,...... learning.... Youtuber

*****************************
sentence: I like to drink Apple Juice. My friend like Mango Juice.

 -> Tokenization -> 

 Sentence1 - I like to drink apple Juice
 Sentence2 - My friend like Mango Juice

 Here there are 11 words and 9 unique words [ 2 repitions - like and Juice]

 These 9 unique words - Vocabulary
